result.title: GIST: Generator-state-Informed Supervision for Tabular Foundation Models
result.summary: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) based on prior-data fitted networks typically use sampled hard query labels, leaving avoidable sampling variability in pretraining. A key observation is that intermediate generator states can reveal label uncertainty beyond a sampled outcome. We propose Generator-state-Informed Supervision for TFMs (GIST), which uses these states to average query losses over conditional label distributions. GIST jointly designs task generation and query supervision, using entropy-calibrated encodings to obtain tractable, input-consistent targets on supported label-dependent branches. We show that this averaging preserves the population objective and yields no larger gradient covariance at fixed parameters within each generating distribution. Under matched pretraining schedules, GIST improves mean rank across three architectures on both TabArena and TALENT without changing architecture or inference. Across these benchmarks and architectures, GIST wins 62.1% of paired dataset-level comparisons against the corresponding hard-label controls.

AI.brief_summary: GIST 面向表格基础模型预训练，指出采样的硬标签会带来采样波动，因此利用任务生成器的中间状态推断标签条件分布，将 query 损失对该分布做熵校准后的平均，从而在不改变架构与推理的前提下提升 TabArena、TALENT 上的平均排名。
AI.relevance_reason: 其核心线索是用生成器内部状态提供的软分布目标替代硬标签监督，可能可供核查如何为 latent 推理状态设计监督信号与贡献分配；但对象是表格数据、不涉及视觉或 latent 推理过程，迁移性需自行判断。
